data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 names a 'shared mechanism' relation but merely redescribes the endpoints: it says both 'invoke source independence and operational independence' and that one 'operationalizes' the other's protocol. Reciting that two nodes both use the same two dimensions is not a substantive shared-mechanism relation; it provides no independent mechanism linking the nodes, only an observation of lexical/structural overlap, so it is refuted as a summary of endpoints.
